capabilities: Create public or private gists from notes on GitHub.com or GitHub Enterprise Server
Update gists automatically or on demand after note edits
Copy or open gist URLs via commands
Optionally include a table of contents and strip front matter in shared gists
extras: Tokens are stored in Obsidian's localStorage, which other plugins could theoretically access; the README advises granting tokens minimal permissions. The README also includes developer release instructions rather than user documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a single note as a shareable GitHub Gist URL.

relations.evidence: Works with GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Server

requires.name: GitHub.com or GitHub Enterprise Server account

summary: Plugin that shares notes as GitHub Gists, creating public or private gist links and keeping them updated with note changes.
